m.s: Finely dice {onion}, {carrot} and {bacon}, and crush {garlic}. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook them for 8 minutes until soft. Turn the heat up, add {beef_mince} and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until well browned.
Stir in {tompaste} for 2 minutes, then add {tintom}, {oregano} and half a tin of water. Simmer for 25 minutes until thick, then season. Heat the oven to 180°C fan.

Melt {butter} in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in {flour} for 1 minute, then whisk in {milk} a splash at a time, letting it thicken before adding more, so it stays smooth. Simmer for 2 minutes, season and stir in half of {cheese}.
In a large baking dish, layer ragu, {lasagne} and white sauce. Repeat twice more, finishing with white sauce. Top with the rest of the cheese and grated {parm}.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until golden and bubbling, and a knife slides through the pasta easily.
Rest for 10 minutes before cutting, so the layers hold together.

l: Cut into portions once cool. One of the best reheat lunches there is. Keeps 4 days in the fridge, and it freezes well.
g: A separate smaller GF lasagne with GF sheets and white sauce made with GF flour. Check the bacon.
